en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a coastal view with several small boats in a bay, a long wooden or metal pier extending out over the water, and a small islet in the distance. In the foreground there is a house and some vegetation. The printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as Praia in Cabo Verde and specifically the Ilheu de Santa Maria and a disembarkation bridge.
